findings.text: non-blocking: the seal is skipped when the target does not exist yet, so a no-write-paths worker can create an absent exclusive directory (for example docs/figures/ in a project that has none) and write into it; unmergeable_seals promises at reckon/_worker_fence.py:1465-1470 that a new name under a sealed directory is refused, and every test fixture pre-creates the directories so the gap is uncovered.

non-blocking: the table states 'Head arm on all_debug at 8e5f6679ab75', but logs/head-arm.log's header records no partition marker and its command is a bare pytest invocation in the worker worktree with no srun, so the done_when's all_debug clause is unshown; the 59-passed result itself is recorded.

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified five production call sites: dispatch composition, two resume paths, the launch planner and the fence composer.
item_verdicts.diff: read four commits against 9c8632ca0b99: reckon/_backends.py threads unmergeable_patterns through launch_plan into fence_argv; reckon/_worker_fence.py adds worktree_write_grant and unmergeable_seals and appends ro-binds after the writable grants; reckon/crew/runs.py adds unmergeable_patterns over DEFAULT_EXCLUSIVE_PATHS plus _SharedWritePaths.exclusive_patterns; launch.py and both resume paths pass them only for undeclared nodes; plus the test file and evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names a test that launches a no-write-paths worker in a temp repo and crew home; tests/test_worker_writes_anywhere_but_unmergeable_paths.py:154-229 asserts the source and new-test writes succeed, one write per exclusive category is refused, a declared node is unsealed, and the negative control refuses the source write, and logs/head-arm.log records 59 passed EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a worker may write anywhere in its worktree except paths git cannot merge; reckon/_worker_fence.py:1434 grants the whole worktree and reckon/_worker_fence.py:1445-1502 seals the exclusive patterns, so an undeclared node is fenced to its worktree minus those paths.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits e4c248e0b6 8e5f6679ab 4153aaf5a4 (the range also carries 086ce1934b, omitted), changed_paths the seven landed files, baseline_suite 2 failures at 9c8632ca0b99 and after_suite 0 at 8e5f6679ab, but rubric.correctness reads '58 of 59 head-arm tests pass' and rubric.self-check reads 'status blocked names the unmet measure' against a head arm of 59 passed EXIT=0 and status complete.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths were reckon/, tests/test_worker_writes_anywhere_but_unmergeable_paths.py and the evidence fragment; git diff --stat 9c8632ca0b99..4153aaf5a4 lists five reckon/ modules, the test file and the fragment, every one inside them.

justifications.durability: logs/negative-control.log is red on test_a_no_write_paths_worker_writes_its_source_and_a_new_test and test_a_declared_node_is_fenced_as_before when worktree_write_grant returns no root, so those two assertions fail on the regression they guard; the seal-skip at reckon/_worker_fence.py:1734 is untested because every fixture pre-creates the directories.
justifications.evidence: logs/head-arm.log reads '59 passed in 16.98s' EXIT=0 at rev 8e5f6679ab and logs/negative-control.log reads '2 failed, 6 passed' EXIT=1, but the head log header carries no partition marker and the command is a bare pytest invocation, so the done_when's all_debug clause is unsubstantiated.
justifications.fit: reckon/_worker_fence.py:1445-1502 states the mechanism in its docstring with no plan, sprint or ticket identifier, and the added comment at reckon/_backends.py:3155-3161 explains why the grant precedes the seal.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_worker_fence.py:1434-1442 grants the whole worktree and reckon/_worker_fence.py:1727-1735 seals exactly the unmergeable paths, which is the goal's rule.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/runs.py:1840-1841 builds on DEFAULT_EXCLUSIVE_PATHS and _SharedWritePaths.exclusive_patterns, the existing owner of exclusive artifact classes, rather than a second pattern list; unmergeable_seals is a new path resolver with no prior owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 9c8632ca0b99..4153aaf5a4 touches only reckon/, tests/test_worker_writes_anywhere_but_unmergeable_paths.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the three declared write paths.
